title: Millions mourn Iran's Supreme Leader at funeral procession in Tehran
summary: Millions of people gathered in Tehran to pay their respects to Iran's former Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, with many expressing anger and calls for vengeance towards the US. The funeral procession was marked by chants of 'kill Trump' and displays of red flags. The event has significant implications for India's strategic relations with Iran.
summary_points: Millions mourned Iran's former Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei in Tehran
The funeral procession was marked by anger and calls for vengeance towards the US, particularly towards President Trump
Many people displayed red flags symbolizing vengeance during the procession
The event has significant implications for India's strategic relations with Iran
India needs to consider how this event may impact its own diplomatic efforts in the region

framing.left: Left-leaning outlets collectively emphasize the anger and calls for vengeance towards the US, particularly President Trump. They also highlight the significance of this event for India's strategic relations with Iran.
framing.center: Centrist coverage frames the story as a significant event in international politics, highlighting the funeral procession and its implications for global relations. However, some outlets note that the event has not received much attention from Indian media.
framing.right: Right-leaning outlets focus on the potential impact of this event on India's strategic autonomy and its relations with Iran. They also emphasize the need for India to take a strong stance against Iranian aggression.

framing_hi.left: वामपंथी समाचार संगठन इस घटना को अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति ट्रम्प के प्रति आक्रोश और वengeance के बुलंद चिल्लाने के रूप में प्रस्तुत करते हैं, जिसने भारत की रणनीतिक संबंधों पर महत्वपूर्ण प्रभाव डाला है।
framing_hi.center: केंद्रीय समाचार संगठन इस घटना को एक महत्वपूर्ण वैश्विक राजनीति घटना के रूप में प्रस्तुत करते हैं, जिसमें शामिल हैं अंतिम संस्कार और इसकी विशेषताएं। हालांकि, कुछ समाचार संगठनों ने यह बताया है कि इस घटना पर भारतीय मीडिया का बहुत कम ध्यान दिया गया है।
framing_hi.right: दाहिनी समाचार संगठन इस घटना को भारत की रणनीतिक स्वतंत्रता और उसके संबंधों के लिए महत्वपूर्ण प्रभाव डालने के लिए अमेरिकी-ईरानी आक्रामकता पर भारत की आवश्यकता के रूप में प्रस्तुत करते हैं।
